notes.title: Post-War Dreams Story Update : Version 0.477
notes.notes:
While we're digesting and embracing all sorts of feedback regarding Post-War Dreams's pre-alpha demo, our writer Wes Loch has finished the whole first draft of the story. And it is mere 32.327 words. Perhaps it is too much for an 2.5 side-scrolling action game, perhaps not. What we know for sure is that the whole premise is full of interesting characters, plot-twists and wonderful dialogues that spans different layers of emotion, especially for an post-apocalyptic setting.

We'll keep you updated and meanwhile enjoy one character portrait, posted below:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/af20f669970c7300cbb3b53c9ba8d08eb287a875.png

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Demo Update : Version 0.469
notes.notes:
Hello everyone;
We have updated the pre-alpha demo of Post-War Dreams based on player feedback. Please feel free to send us more bug reports.

Here's the recent changes;

* Fixed idle state animations.
* Added more tutorial text.
* Fixed collision errors in various parts of the level.
* Fixed floating player error in some cases.
* Pistol now has more accuracy and better aiming.
* Updated the tutorial for frontal cover.
* Fixed wrong camera angles happening in certain re-loading check points.
* Re-made the fire animations in main menu.
* Fixed floating text in smaller resolutions.

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Version 0.465
notes.notes:
Work is steady on Post-War Dreams. Even though the game will be launched as "Early Access" we are fully aware of the whole gaming community's concerns about Early Access, therefore we'll do our best to include as much as content possible at launch. 

With this opportunity, we'd like to stress one more time that, we do NOT see Early Access as a source of income to complete the project. We already have enough funds to finalize the game we want. However, this kind of project is rather "large" in scope, therefore it definately needs player base input. We also want to evolve the story aspect of the game with the feedback from the community.

Here is one gif from the new level we've been working on. The climbing animations of the main character are totally place-holder assets, they will be re-worked.

Since Post-War Dreams is a 2.5 side-scrolling game, we'd want to experiment with all sorts of platforming action.

http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/840335403113469589/4D6632ED43275FED6C614AEA013C495FD8F3BBD3/

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Version 0.46
notes.notes:
No Post-Apocalyptic game is complete without zombies, right?
Here's very early w.i.p verson of a new enemy type you'll find in Post-War Dreams.

Apart from our main adverseries like the Remnants and Militias who will fight you with their rifles and pistols, we now have free roaming merciless "infected" ones to chase you around.

Now, back to performance optimization so that we'll fill the screen with many many of these zombies:)

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Version 0.45
notes.notes:
Working is steady on Post-War Dreams, our post-apocalyptic 2.5-D Action/Rpg set in USA wasteland after the fall. Last week, we were busy tweaking the post process effects of the game to find balance between city ruins sections and forest areas. 

Below is a w.i.p screenshot from forest level. We're trying to find a contrast between the colorful look of comic books and try to blend that look in a post-apocalyptic setting.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28679634/bf160639f83640608793497eeda9bd228b9c57d6.jpg

notes.title: Post-War Dreams Version 0.3
notes.notes:
We're doing constant tweaks to shooting mechanicism and we realize that it is one of the hardest things in video games to balance properly.

That's why we aim to balance it with the feedback we receive from the community.

In Post-War Dreams, the story and character interaction is equally important to us as well as action and combat mechanics.

http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/777281580207576698/C9FDDEE60BA2DFC974E9B761F0D5E0B660BEF49B/

notes.notes:

We are happy that our Pre-Alpha build, version V.02 is ready for internal testing and contains four chapters.

Our writer Wes Locher is very busy adding new content and the whole PWD texts are over 50.000 words already. Maybe that's too much of words but we want to present a rich, background world and lore, not just side-scrolling action.

Stay tuned!
